en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small European village in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows tightly clustered houses with steep, gabled roofs and a few larger multi‑story buildings that resemble inns or townhouses. A railway line with several train cars and a small station lies at the edge of the village. Winding country roads lead through cultivated fields and meadows toward scattered farmhouses and two prominent larger buildings on the hills, one of which is likely a church or chapel. Dense forest covers the higher surrounding hills. The image edges are worn and irregular, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.
